name: Car-Makes-Explorer
description: Car-Makes-Explorer is a free and open source web application that enables users to explore car manufacturers and view detailed information on their available models. The application leverages the CarQuery API—a fully free API that requires no registration—and is built using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap 5 for responsive design. By Bocaletto

paragraphs: Car-Makes-Explorer is a free and open source web application that enables users to explore car manufacturers and view detailed information on their available models. The application leverages the CarQuery API—a fully free API that requires no registration—and is built using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap 5 for responsive design.
Car-Makes-Explorer is passionately developed by Bocaletto Luca, a dedicated advocate for building 100% free, open source, and open data web applications.
Enjoy exploring car data and happy coding, oh yeah friend!
features: Dynamic Car Makes and Models Explorer:
Browse a comprehensive list of car makes and view detailed information on the available models.
Quickly search and filter car manufacturers by name.
On selecting a car make, view in-depth details such as manufacturer details and the list of models associated with that make.
